I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Crispy tortilla cones filled with juicy spiced beef and topped with melted mozzarella 🧀🔥 The perfect crunchy snack or quick dinner that everyone will love. One bite and you’re hooked 🤤 Crispy Beef Cones (12 cones) Ingredients For the cones:  • 6 tortillas (25–30 cm / 10–12 inches)  • Toothpicks For the topping:  • Mozzarella cheese, 100 g  • Chopped parsley, 1 tsp For the beef mixture:  • Ground beef, 400 g(0.8lb)   • 1 yellow onion, finely chopped  • Garlic, 4 cloves, minced  • Red bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Green bell pepper, diced (about 1 small)  • Tomato paste, 1 big tbsp   • Soy milk, 100 ml (~ ½ cup) Seasoning:  • Paprika, 1 tbsp  • Chili powder, 1 tsp  • Turmeric, 1 tsp  • Garlic powder, 1 tsp  • Black pepper, 1 tsp  • Garam masala, 1 tsp  • Salt, ½ tsp Instructions 1.⁠ ⁠Prepare the beef mixture:  • Heat a little oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and sauté until soft.  • Add the minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.  • Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks.  • Stir in tomato paste, soy milk, diced bell peppers, and all seasonings. Cook until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and let cool slightly. 2.⁠ ⁠Prepare the cones:  • Cut tortillas in half. Roll each half into a cone shape and secure the edge with a toothpick. Baking Method:  1. Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).  2. Place cones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. Lightly spray with cooking spray.  3. Bake for 10–12 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Return to oven for 5 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. Air Fryer Method:   1. Preheat air fryer to 180°C (356°F).  2. Lightly spray cones with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket. Make sure they don’t touch each other.  3. Air fry for 6–8 minutes until crispy and golden.  4. Carefully fill each cone with the beef mixture and top with mozzarella cheese.  5. Air fry again for 3–4 minutes until cheese melts.  6. Garnish with parsley and serve warm. #crispybeef #quickrecipes #easyrecipes #lazydinner #beefcones

Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Crockpot Chicken Pasta Ingredients • 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tbsp Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning • 1 jar marinara sauce (24 oz) • 1 jar Alfredo sauce (15 oz) • 1 block cream cheese (8 oz) • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 1 bag shredded mozzarella cheese (8 oz) • Parsley flakes, for garnish Instructions 1. Add the chicken breasts to the crockpot and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and Kinder’s Buttery Garlic & Herb Seasoning. 2. Pour in the marinara sauce and Alfredo sauce. Add the cream cheese and minced garlic, then gently mix everything together. 3. Cover and cook on HIGH for 3 hours, or until the chicken is fully cooked and tender. 4. Remove the chicken, shred it with two forks, and return it to the crockpot. 5. Add the shredded mozzarella cheese and stir until the cheese is melted and everything is creamy and combined. 6. Top with parsley flakes and serve. #crockpotrecipes #chickenpasta #slowcookerrecipes #easyrecipes #comfortfood

Чтобы приготовить классические тонкие блинчики на молоке, вам понадобится базовый набор ингредиентов и 20 минут времени. Блинчики по этому рецепту получаются нежными, эластичными и легко переворачиваются.ИнгредиентыМолоко (теплое) — 500 млПшеничная мука — 200 г (около 1,5 стакана)Яйца — 3 штукиСахар — 2 ст. ложкиРастительное масло — 3 ст. ложкиСоль — 0,5 ч. ложкиПошаговое приготовление1. Сделайте основу тестаВ глубокой миске смешайте яйца, сахар и соль. Взбейте массу венчиком или миксером до появления легкой пены.2. Введите часть молокаВлейте к яйцам примерно 150-200 мл теплого молока и перемешайте. Если добавить все молоко сразу, в тесте при добавлении муки образуются комочки.3. Добавьте мукуПросейте всю муку в миску. Тщательно вымешайте венчиком до получения густого, абсолютно однородного теста.4. Разведите тестоПостепенно влейте оставшееся молоко, постоянно помешивая массу венчиком. В самом конце добавьте растительное масло. Оставьте тесто «отдохнуть» на 10-15 минут при комнатной температуре.5. Пожарьте блинчикиХорошо разогрейте сковороду. Смажьте её каплей масла только перед первым блином. Наливайте тесто половником, быстро распределяя его по дну круговыми движениями сковороды. Жарьте на среднем огне по 1-2 минуты с одной стороны (до золотистых краев) и около 30 секунд со второй.Секреты идеальных блиновТемпература: Молоко и яйца должны быть комнатной температуры или слегка теплыми, чтобы клейковина муки лучше разошлась.Масло в тесте: Растительное масло внутри смеси не даст блинчикам пригорать, и вам не придется смазывать сковороду каждый раз.Нежность: Чтобы блины оставались мягкими, складывайте их стопкой на тарелку и смазывайте каждый кусочком сливочного масла.Скажите, вы планируете делать блинчики с начинкой или кушать просто так? Replying to @YT but anyway my Cheesy Baked Mac n Cheese recipe: (Flavored, Creamy & Crispy on Top)
 
 Ingredients:
 
 For the base:
 1 lb pasta (elbows or shells work great)
 8 oz freshly grated Colby Jack
 8 oz freshly grated mozzarella
 8 oz freshly grated sharp cheddar
 5 tbsp unsalted butter
 8 cloves garlic, finely minced
 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
 ½ cup reserved pasta water
 
 Creamy spice mix:
 2½ cups heavy cream
 4 oz cream cheese
 2 tsp paprika
 2 tsp garlic powder
 2 tsp onion powder
 ¼ tsp chili powder
 2 tbsp hot sauce (like Frank’s Red Hot)
 1 tsp black pepper
 ½ tsp salt (adjust to taste)
 
 ⸻
 
 How to Make It:
 1. Cook your pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve about ½ cup of that pasta water before draining, then set both aside.
 2. Make the flavor base: In a saucepan, combine the heavy cream, cream cheese, and all your seasonings (paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, salt, pepper, and hot sauce). Whisk it all together on medium-low heat until smooth and slightly thickened—don’t let it boil, just let it gently simmer.
 3. Build your roux: In a large skillet or pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add in the garlic and sauté for about 2-3 minutes until fragrant. Then sprinkle in your flour and whisk continuously for another 2-3 minutes to cook off the raw flour taste.
 4. Bring it together: Slowly pour the creamy spice mixture into your garlic-butter roux, whisking as you go. Let it simmer for a couple more minutes until everything’s nice and velvety.
 5. Loosen it up: Stir in the reserved pasta water to thin the sauce just slightly.
 6. Cheese it up: Add in your shredded cheeses a handful at a time, stirring until everything is fully melted and smooth.
 7. Taste & tweak: Give the sauce a taste—this is your chance to adjust salt or spice if you want it bolder.
 8. Mix in the pasta: Add your cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and gently stir until everything is coated in that creamy goodness.
 9. Bake it off: Transfer the mac to a baking dish. You can layer with more cheese between if you want it extra decadent, or just top it off with a layer of cheese for a crispy finish.
 10. Bake: Pop it into a 350ºF oven for 15–20 minutes. When it’s bubbly, hit it with the broiler for a minute or two to get that golden cheesy crust (watch it closely so it doesn’t burn).
 11. Serve: Let it cool for a minute, then dig in and enjoy the creamiest, cheesiest mac ever. #macandcheese #cookwithme #cheese #pastarecipe

Recipe Name Slow Cooker Brown Sugar Glazed Pork Chops Ingredients 1. 6 thick-cut boneless pork chops 2. 1/3 cup brown sugar 3. 1/4 cup soy sauce 4. 1/4 cup chicken broth 5. 2 tbsp honey 6. 2 tbsp olive oil 7. 4 cloves garlic, minced 8. 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 1 tsp smoked paprika 10. 1 tsp garlic powder 11. 1/2 tsp onion powder 12. 1/2 tsp black pepper 13. 1/2 tsp salt 14. 1 tbsp cornstarch 15. 2 tbsp cold water 16. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Pat the pork chops dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and onion powder. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Sear the pork chops for 2–3 minutes per side until nicely browned. 5. Transfer the seared pork chops to the slow cooker. 6. Whisk together brown sugar, soy sauce, chicken broth, honey, Worcestershire sauce, and minced garlic. 7. Pour the glaze mixture evenly over the pork chops. 8. Cover and cook on LOW for about 3–4 hours, or until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C). 9. Carefully remove the pork chops and place them on a plate. 10. Pour the cooking liquid into a saucepan and bring it to a gentle simmer. 11. Mix cornstarch with cold water until completely smooth. 12. Slowly whisk the cornstarch mixture into the simmering sauce. 13. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the sauce becomes thick, glossy, and sticky. 14. Return the pork chops to the sauce and spoon the glaze generously over each piece. 15. Let the pork rest for a few minutes so it stays juicy. 16.
